integrity: The proof is symbolic. A standalone exact-integer checker reconstructs h* from the floor formula and verifies the factorizations and criterion through r=400, with an independent Reid--Tai/divisibility scan of the boundary through r=60. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the Gorenstein canonical/non-terminal boundary of the two-non-unit-weight family. It does not classify h*-unimodality for non-Gorenstein canonical spaces, terminal interior points, or higher-support weighted projective spaces.
title: Sharp h*-unimodality criterion on the Gorenstein canonical boundary of P(1^r,a,b)
